question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 3
solution:
The correct answer is '**on**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The preposition "on" is used to indicate the basis or foundation of something, which fits the context of the sentence.
 
• The phrase "live on" is a common expression meaning to depend on or be sustained by something.
 
• Other options ("into", "by", and "in") do not fit correctly with the expression "live on" in this context.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 4**'.
